translation: Thirty-one points in all. The separate collateral of the Du vessel, going from Changqiang to the Ren vessel, ascends straight from the lower abdomen, pierces the center of the navel, ascends piercing the heart, enters the throat, ascends the chin, encircles the lip, ascends to connect the center below both eyes, and meets Taiyang at the Jingming point (BL1) at the inner canthus. (See under Yin Qiao.) It ascends the forehead and meets Foot-Jueyin together at the crown.
